name: XCC_CB_KEY_SEGMENTS
description: This table stores the control budget account segments and thier mappings to either accounting flex field segments, project segments or project planning segments.

columns.name: KEY_SEGMENT_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: The segment of the budgetary control flexfield that the data will be stored in

columns.name: SOURCE_SEGMENT_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Either a segment from COA segments or a project DFF or a project element which is mapped to this budget key segment

columns.name: SOURCE_SEGMENT_TYPE
columns.description: This indicates what the mapped segment is a COA segment or project DFF segment or project element

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Order of segments in budget COA and in control budget UI

columns.name: TREE_CODE
columns.description: The tree that will be used for the segment budgetary control

columns.name: DEFAULT_TREE_ROLLUP_VALUE
columns.description: The segment value to be used when the segment value provided by the transaction does not roll up to any value for the tree level in the tree version that is specified for the segment.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
